password.title: Change password
password.notice: After changing your password you will be signed out on every device.
password.changed: Password changed. Please sign in with your new password.

errors.required: Please fill in all password fields.
errors.weak: New password does not meet the requirements.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Require a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) when you sign in.
mfa.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
mfa.disableHint: Enter a code from your authenticator app or one of your backup codes to turn off 2FA.
mfa.backupWarning: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
